title: Integration registry record
description: Per provider: verified capability matrix, entitlements, freshness SLO, contract reference, owner and connection status.

title: Feed integrity log
description: Per received file or message: origin verification result, hash, sequence, duplicate or replay rejection.

title: Funds-flow conformance result
description: Per deployment: tests executed, account inventory, credential inventory and pass or fail.

title: Custody account register
description: Legal title, owner, purpose, restrictions and attribution method for every custody account.

title: Custody reconciliation pack
description: Folio-rendered pack: custodian statement reference, subledger balances, differences and resolution.
producer: not yet assigned (intended renderer: Folio, not operated for Unbound)

title: Custodian assurance review record
description: Report metadata, reviewer conclusions, exceptions, CUEC mapping and bridge-letter status per custodian.

title: Instruction authorization trail
description: Per instruction: requester, approvers, authority reference, limits checked, idempotency key, provider acknowledgments and settlement evidence.

title: Degraded-mode event log
description: Entry and exit of degraded states, affected funds, holds applied and escalations.

title: Custodian recovery drill record
description: Planned exercise of outage and transition scenarios with results.
